o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دیرنق (dırnaq), from Proto-Turkic *tïrŋak. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐱃𐰃𐰺𐰭𐰴 (tïrŋaq, “fingernail”), Turkish and Crimean Tatar tırnak, etc.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish صورمق (sormaq), from Proto-Turkic *sōr-.
From Proto-Turkic *sōr(a)- (“to ask”). Likely cognate with Chuvash шыра (šyra).
